label: x-initial sequence, step after a j-j / j-u bigram (t=3-5)
explanation: Extremely sparse conjunctive feature (37 dev activations). Fires during the original phase at t=3-5 on the token right after the bigram j-u or j-j (prev2_tok=j at 34x lift, prev_tok u/j). Magnitude is highest when the sequence also starts with x (87% of mass) and when the current input is the digit 3 (64% of mass); top example: x n j u [3]. Weaker activations happen with only some of these cues present (e.g. n j j [3], x u b u [3]). The predicate gets ~72% of mass but has low precision (~18%), because many x...j u / x...j j contexts do not fire, so the exact trigger is a fuzzy conjunction. Never fires in the copy phase, at t<3, or at t>6.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 13 cues. Raise it: orig0=x (+2.83), prev_tok=u (+2.21), prev2_tok=j (+2.18), orig2=j (+1.65), prev_tok=j (+1.51), phase=0 & in_tok=3 (+1.35). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-1.65), orig_idx=-1 (-1.34), in_first=0 (-1.31).
